note: Slice 4 scenario: EAF -> LRF -> CCM -> billet yard as a ladle CYCLE. Consumes Slice 2 prepared_charge and Slice 3 dri_charge_material contracts (v1, embedded in fixtures/slice2/s2_scrap_charge_scenario_seed11_120.json under 'contracts'). Deterministic scripted scenario, no RNG in the rule path (same shape as the Slice 2 mirror). Expected outputs are derived by the mirror run (mirror = single source of truth); the fixture asserts invariants (balance closure every tick, event ticks, cycle-state snapshots) not intermediate numbers. EXPECTATIONS REWRITTEN to mirror-derived values (Yasser GO 2026-10-15): mirror physics = same-tick LRF->CCM handoff + gated tapping (heat starts only when a charge is delivered AND a ladle is free). Old hand-derived event ticks assumed a 1-tick offset and a single heat; mirror run (single run, 2026-10-15) gives 5 heats, energy 120000 kWh (5 x 40 t x 600 kWh/t), billet end 186.935 t. Caster wait is physically unreachable at this cadence — asserted as 0, not 4. Starved count 65 is idle-tick starvation accounting (EAF idle with no delivered charge), asserted as invariant, not a bottleneck claim. KEY_TICKS REWRITTEN to mirror-exposed quantities only (Yasser decision 2026-10-15); N3 reachability clause extended with the handoff condition — at current cadence the caster wait is unreachable by same-tick handoff, so the fixture asserts 0, not 4.

scenario.win_condition: 5 charges delivered and processed through the full ladle cycle (tap -> LRF -> CCM -> billet yard) before their deadlines, with material balance closed every tick
scenario.feasibility_check: Winning sequence hand-derived from stage order before shipping: deliveries at ticks 1/12/24/36/48; EAF heat 10 ticks, LRF 4, CCM 6, 2 ladles. C1: heat starts tick 2 (delivery at 1, ladle L1 free), taps tick 12, LRF 12-16, CCM 16-22, billet at 22 < deadline 30. C2: delivered at 12, heat starts 13 (L2), taps 23, LRF 23-27, CCM 27-33, billet 33 < 42. C3: delivered 24, heat 25-35 (L1 free after C1 cast at 22), taps 35, LRF 35-39, CCM 39-45, billet 45 < 54. C4: delivered 36, heat 37-47 (L2 free after 33), taps 47, LRF 47-51, CCM 51-57, billet 57 < 66. C5: delivered 48, heat 49-59 (L1 free after 45), taps 59, LRF 59-63, CCM 63-69, billet 69 < 78. Caster wait fires at ticks 34-38 (L2 refined at 27 waits while CCM casts C3's ladle from 39? no — verify by mirror run). Mirror run is the arbiter; fixture asserts event ticks + balance closure, not hand-derived intermediates.

caster_wait_reachability.requires: ladles >= 2 AND ccm_ticks > lrf_ticks AND a refined ladle can finish LRF on a tick where the strand is busy (handoff condition)
caster_wait_reachability.handoff_condition_at_current_cadence: unreachable — same-tick LRF->CCM handoff means a refined ladle takes the strand immediately; a second ladle can only wait if its LRF completion lands inside a strand-busy window, which requires arrival cadence < ccm_ticks_per_ladle (12 > 6 here)
